Gold, silver, platinum and palladium all closed the week lower, palladium's 6.5% drop the steepest of the four. Platinum fell least at 1.32%; gold fell 1.84%, silver 2.61%, Friday 4 September to Friday 11 September. Gold fell every session this desk verified — Thursday's tape never printed after a network fault. Full tape on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
